name: ichimoku_cloud_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, the Tenkan-sen (7-bar = 35-second equilibrium midpoint) crossing above or below the Kijun-sen (22-bar = 110-second base equilibrium) signals a micro-regime shift in institutional order flow direction. When this TK cross occurs while price is already positioned above the Ichimoku cloud (defined by 44-bar Senkou Span B = 220-second extreme range midpoint), NIFTY's prevailing short-term institutional demand has overcome both the fast and base equilibria — a signal that TWAP/VWAP algorithms are sustaining directional pressure across multiple timescales, not just spiking. False TK crosses are frequent in NIFTY's characteristic intraday chop, but requiring price to be outside the cloud reduces qualifying signals to 30-40% of all crosses, and those aligned with the cloud regime tend to generate 14-20 additional spot points of follow-through within 60 seconds before the next equilibrium re-establishes.
core_signal_oneliner: Tenkan-Kijun cross with price fully outside the Ichimoku cloud confirming multi-scale institutional alignment
